深入地下城的分支追寻失踪的巫师，奶酪与可能发生的死亡。
Venture deep into the sub-dungeons in pursuit of missing wizards, cheese and probable death.
伟大的弗拉德再次从危险而英勇的远征中回来了！这次，他打败了可怕的邪神，拯救了中原大陆！ 为了表示感谢，巫师们自发地决定举办一场宏大的派对来庆祝他们深深敬爱的老师所达成的荣耀功绩！ 准备活动都已经完成了，但是还差一样东西—奶酪。 通过普选，一组巫师被选出来进入地下城找来一片“超旧蓝奶酪”…… 但是可怕的事情发生了……
Shown at the start of the level, narrated by Vlad.

The great Vlad had once again returned from a dangerous and heroic quest! This time he had stopped the horrible Cthulhu from destroying the world of Midgård! As a gesture of appreciation, the wizards spontaneously decided to arrange a magnificent party to celebrate their beloved teacher’s fantastic feat! The preparations were complete, but one thing was missing -- the cheese. By popular vote, a group of wizards were chosen to venture into the dungeons to seek out a wedge of “Extra Aged Blue Cheese”... But something went horribly wrong...
